description: This script converts an Excel sheet describing test cases into Playwright test files. It reads input parameters, processes an Excel file, and generates TypeScript test scripts based on the specified test cases.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for input file, sheet name, and help flag.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates a directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes input names to be valid file names or identifiers.

methods.name: generateTestFile
methods.description: Generates Playwright test script content from parsed test case data and writes it to a file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates argument parsing, reading the Excel file, processing data, and generating test scripts.
